definitions.gloss: pet owner; owner of an animal; keeper
definitions.explanation: The person who owns and is responsible for taking care of a pet or other domesticated animal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飼|か}い{主|ぬし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧いった。
examples.english: The dog ran to its owner.

examples.japanese: {飼|か}い{主|ぬし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ペット→ペット：02959_petto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please walk your pet under the owner's responsibility.

examples.japanese: ⟦{迷子|まいご}→迷子：03729_maigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飼|か}い{主|ぬし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦チラシ→チラシ：23406_chirashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}った→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: I distributed flyers around the neighborhood to find the owner of the lost cat.

notes:
USAGE:
{飼|か}い{主|ぬし} is a compound of ⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧ (to keep/raise an animal) and ⟦{主|ぬし}→主：30578_nushi⟧ (owner). It is the standard term for a pet owner in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ペット→ペット：02959_petto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飼|か}い{主|ぬし} (pet owner)
- {飼|か}い{主|ぬし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧ (owner's responsibility)
- {飼|か}い{主|ぬし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかる→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧ (the owner is found)
- {飼|か}い{主|ぬし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{懐|なつ}く→懐く：17463_natsuku⟧ (to be attached to one's owner)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飼|か}い{主|ぬし}: pet owner, animal keeper (standard term)
- ⟦{飼育員|しいくいん}→飼育員：17861_shiikuin⟧: animal caretaker, zookeeper (professional)
- ⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧: owner (of objects, not specifically animals)
